name: kinconductor
description: KinConductor KC868-Ax ESP32 firmware with typed serial profiles, Modbus RTU, eBUS TCP, BLE presence, IFTTT capabilities, calibrated inputs, PWM and OLED grids

scripts.build:ax-base: pio run -e kc868-a4 -e kc868-a8 -e kc868-a8s -e kc868-a16 -e kc868-a32 -e kc868-a64 -e kc868-a128
scripts.build:all: pio run -e kc868-a6-base -e kc868-a6 -e kc868-a4 -e kc868-a8 -e kc868-a8s -e kc868-a16 -e kc868-a32 -e kc868-a64 -e kc868-a128 -e kc868-a6-coprocessor
scripts.build:fs:all: pio run -e kc868-a6-base -e kc868-a6 -e kc868-a4 -e kc868-a8 -e kc868-a8s -e kc868-a16 -e kc868-a32 -e kc868-a64 -e kc868-a128 -e kc868-a6-coprocessor -t buildfs
scripts.test: npm run test:native && npm run test:web
scripts.test:web: node --check data/app.js && node --check data/capabilities.js && node --test test/test_web.js test/test_capability_ui.js test/test_release.js

author: Robert Rupa
